name: Warp
long_description:
Warp is a modern, AI-native employee management platform for high-growth companies.

We’ve raised $85M from Battery Ventures, Peak XV, Sapphire, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher), A-Star, Abstract, SV Angel & Homebrew Capital. 

We are humbled to have the backing from people who have built some of the most important companies of the last two decades: Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke, Stripe COO Claire Hughes Johnson, Dropbox co-founders Drew Houston and Arash Ferdowsi, Coinbase CTO Balaji Srinivasan, Eventbrite founder Kevin Hartz, Cruise founder Kyle Vogt, and Replit founder Amjad Masad.
one_liner: AI-native Employee Management Platform for High-Growth Companies
